usedFor: Product Hunt surfaces launches, and Asana receives the work through “Create Task or Subtask” after each Product Hunt event.

bestTemplate.name: “When a product becomes hot” in Product Hunt, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A hot product is worth a look today, so Asana gets a task for someone to review it.

watchOut: “When a product becomes hot” is polling, so the Asana task appears after a scheduled check, not at the vote.
